nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
Image model comparison: ONE prompt, ONE seed, ~1024x1024, nine models plus a prompt card, one labeled sheet.

1. Edit 'Prompt (shared)' (and optionally Seed / Width / Height / Negative).
2. Switch a model off: click its group title, press Ctrl+B (bypass). The sheet still builds from the other tiles.
3. Run. Open-model groups use Comfy Cloud GPU time; API groups spend credits (see the cost note in each API group).
4. Outputs: compare/<model> (each image) and compare/sheet (labeled 5x2 sheet (prompt card + 9 models)).

Not every model can take every shared setting. Read the Note inside each group before trusting a comparison: API groups use fixed 1K presets (shared Width/Height drive only the three open models); seeds are best-effort or ignored on several API models.

nodes.title: Note: FLUX.2 [dev]
widgets_values:
OPEN MODEL, runs on Comfy Cloud GPU (bills GPU time, no fixed price shown).
Based on official template: image_flux2_text_to_image (Flux.2 Dev Text to Image), subgraph flattened. Defaults kept: euler, 20 steps, FluxGuidance 4, Turbo LoRA OFF (toggle = 8 steps).
Shared prompt, seed, width, height: all used.
No negative prompt (FLUX.2 has none).
VAE is the template's full_encoder_small_decoder; flux2-vae also exists on cloud.
FLUX.2 [klein] 9B (image_flux2_text_to_image_9b, 2026-01-16) is newer, but [dev] was used as requested.

nodes.title: Nano Banana 2.1 (API)
widgets_values:
You are an expert image-generation engine. You must ALWAYS produce an image.
Interpret all user input—regardless of format, intent, or abstraction—as literal visual directives for image composition.
If a prompt is conversational or lacks specific visual details, you must creatively invent a concrete visual scenario that depicts the concept.
Prioritize generating the visual representation above any text, formatting, or conversational requests.

nodes.title: Note: cost and differences
widgets_values:
Node GeminiNanoBanana2V2, model 'Gemini Nano Banana 2.1', 1K, thinking MINIMAL.
Chosen over Nano Banana Pro (GeminiImage2Node, gemini-3-pro): newer, has a seed input, and costs less at 1K.
Price: $0.048048 (1K image 0.048048 + thinking MINIMAL 0).
Differs from shared options: no pixel size (aspect 1:1 + 1K resolution only, exact pixels not specified); no negative prompt; seed is best effort, output not guaranteed deterministic.
Estimated cost per run: $0.048048 = about 10.14 credits (price_badge from the cloud catalog; credits at about 211 per USD, HQ-measured, docs.comfy.org gives no rate).

nodes.title: Note: sheet
widgets_values:
Collects labeled tiles in this order: [prompt card], FLUX.2 [dev], Z-Image Turbo, Qwen-Image 2512, Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image 2.5, Seedream 5.0 Pro, FLUX 3 Image, Ideogram 4.5, Kling 3.0 Image.
The prompt card (shared prompt text) lives in 'Shared settings' and is never bypassed: Batch Images always has its first input, so any model group can be bypassed (Ctrl+B) and the others still fill the grid (later tiles move up).
Each tile is 768x768 plus a 96 px label strip; the sheet is 5 columns x 2 rows, 8 px padding.
